# RM COCO

> > RM COCO is a luxury fabric and custom furnishings provider offering designer collections including Tommy Bahama, Crypton, Sunbrella, and Wesco Fabrics, along with custom workroom services for interior design professionals.

RM COCO specializes in contract-grade and performance fabrics for upholstery, drapery, and window treatments, featuring exclusive collections like COCO Privé, COCO Luxe, COCO Suites, COCO Classics, and COCO Allure. The company operates a full-service custom workroom and provides comprehensive support through territory sales managers across the United States.
